notes.en: Public preview 0.3.2. New large Share a link uploads can send the next encrypted part while the previous part awaits storage confirmation, with at most two requests. Also includes batched durable receive writes. Older servers and restored uploads keep serial sending. Transfers remain foreground-only; no specific network speed is promised. Direct APK; no Google Play or Play Billing.
notes.zh: 公开预览版 0.3.2。新建的大文件分享链接上传可在上一片等待保存确认时发送下一片，最多同时两个请求；并包含接收端批量持久化写入优化。旧服务端和恢复任务保持顺序上传。传输仍需保持应用在前台，不承诺具体网络速度。仅以 APK 分发，不在 Google Play 上架，不含 Play 结算。
